module: Undoable (undo/redo) actions of the level editor for scene objects: creation, deletion (object or whole group, restored by serialization), field or dynamic field change, selection, transform, scale, hook call. Each action is recorded via `editor.history:commitAction`. The module returns a FUNCTION: calling it installs `editor.lockObjectSelectionWithUndo` & co on `editor` then returns the function table (M). An editor tool uses the `...WithUndo` functions to make its modifications undoable.
notes: Field values are strings (e.g. "true"/"false" for locked/hidden). A numeric arrayIndex >= 0 is converted to a string; nil becomes "".
A position/rotation/scale change recomputes the selection bbox (editor.computeSelectionBBox).

Emitted hooks: onEditorObjectAdded(objectId), onEditorInspectorFieldChanged(objectIds, fieldName, values, arrayIndex), onEditorInspectorDynFieldChanged(objectIds, fieldName, values, arrayIndex), onEditorObjectSelectionChanged().
`changeObjectFieldMultipleValuesUndo/Redo` exist in the file but are not exported; `changeObjectFieldMultipleValuesWithUndo` is not in M either (inferred: absent from the export list).
A locked object (isLocked) is not deleted by deleteObjectRedo; the action is still pushed onto the stack.

Deleting a group (SimSet/SimGroup) serializes the whole hierarchy (JSON per object) and restores it with the same ids (SimObject.setForcedId); the order in the parent group is restored via nextObjIdInGroup.

createObjectUndo.desc: Undoes a creation: deletes the object actionData.objectId and sets objectId to nil.

createObjectRedo.desc: Creates an object of class actionData.className, registers it under actionData.name and adds it to the group actionData.parentId or to MissionGroup; remembers the new id (reuses the old one via setForcedId) and emits onEditorObjectAdded.

returns.desc: id of the created object (nil if MissionGroup is absent)

deleteObjectUndo.desc: Restores the deleted object (or whole group) from serializedData with its original id, puts it back before nextObjIdInGroup and emits onEditorObjectAdded.

deleteObjectRedo.desc: Serializes the object (or the group hierarchy) then deletes it with editor.deleteObject, unless it is locked.

changeObjectFieldUndo.desc: Restores the old field values on all objects, updates the gizmo/bbox and emits onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.

changeObjectFieldRedo.desc: Applies the new field value on all objects and emits onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.

changeObjectDynFieldUndo.desc: Restores the old values of a dynamic field and emits onEditorInspectorDynFieldChanged.

changeObjectDynFieldRedo.desc: Applies the new value of a dynamic field and emits onEditorInspectorDynFieldChanged.

selectObjectsUndo.desc: Restores the old selection (oldSelection), recomputes the bbox and emits onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.

selectObjectsRedo.desc: Applies the new selection (newSelection), recomputes the bbox and emits onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.

setObjectTransformUndo.desc: Restores the old transform (oldTransform, table converted to a matrix) on the object.

createObjectWithUndo.desc: Creates an object via an undoable "CreateObject" action and marks the editor as modified.

deleteObjectWithUndo.desc: Deletes an object via an undoable "DeleteObject" action, clears the selection and marks the editor as modified.

deleteSelectedObjectsWithUndo.desc: Deletes all the selected objects in a single "DeleteSelectedObjects" transaction. Does nothing if the selection is empty.

changeObjectFieldWithUndo.desc: Changes a field on several objects while remembering the old values (getField).

changeObjectFieldMultipleValuesWithUndo.desc: Like changeObjectFieldWithUndo but with a different value per object.

changeObjectFieldWithOldValues.desc: Like changeObjectFieldWithUndo but the caller supplies the old values itself (useful when the field was already modified during an interactive edit).

oldFieldValues.desc: old values, same order as objIds

changeObjectDynFieldWithUndo.desc: Changes a dynamic field on several objects in an undoable way.

arrayIndex.desc: index (not converted to a string here)

callHookWithUndo.desc: Records a "CallHook" action whose undo and redo both call extensions.hook(hookName, ...).

selectObjectsWithUndo.desc: Changes the object selection in an undoable way. Ignores the call if the old and new selections are equal, or if the last action is already a SelectObjects with the same new selection.

editor.desc: Functions added to `editor` when the function returned by the module is called. They act on editor.selection.object.
